name: Anti-Aliasing for Splatting
definition: A splatting-based anti-aliasing method designed to avoid sample-rate aliasing artifacts (prealiasing) that arise from the resampling phase when the integration grid sampling frequency is insufficient.
summary: Anti-Aliasing for Splatting prevents aliasing in perspective volume rendering by scaling splat size and attenuating energy for distant primitives to maintain constant energy per unit area.
